pool.note: Each key is an active stress kind of the record (the draw flattens every active stress's list), so the kind is key-guaranteed. under_siege#2.short ('inside the walls') has a defence-free twin in data/defenceTwinLines.js applied after the draw. mass_migration does NOT fix the direction (migration.js: the entry may be an exodus), so the lines about arrivals/newcomers/admission need migration: influx. famine#1.short, indebted#1.short and slave_revolt#2.short name 'the council' acting as this place's authority → ruler: council (judgement; a lord-ruled place with an advisory council would be a false negative). monster_pressure#0.short presumes NO garrison ('without the garrison they were supposed to have') and has no twin, yet monster_pressure mandates a Garrison Commander wherever a garrison stands. Unexpressed: occupied#1.short a resistance; religious_conversion#1.short the old faith's endowments/properties (temple not named, not declared); wartime#2.short a conscription quota. {commodity}/{topFaction} slots carry renderer fallbacks: not atoms.
